chapter-1/index.title: Chapter 1: Introduction to AI-Native Development
chapter-1/index.description: This chapter provides an overview of AI-Native Development, establishing the foundational concepts that will be built upon throughout the book.

chapter-1/topic-1.title: Defining AI-Native
chapter-1/topic-1.description: AI-Native development represents a paradigm shift from traditional software development. Rather than simply adding AI capabilities to existing applications, AI-Native systems are architected with artificial intelligence as the foundational element.

chapter-1/topic-2.title: AI-Native vs Traditional Development
chapter-1/topic-2.description: While traditional software development follows a deterministic approach where specific inputs produce predictable outputs, AI-Native development embraces probabilistic and adaptive systems.

chapter-2/index.title: Chapter 2: Infrastructure for AI-Native Systems
chapter-2/index.description: This chapter explores the infrastructure requirements and architectural patterns for supporting AI-Native applications.

chapter-2/topic-1.title: Modern Cloud Architectures
chapter-2/topic-1.description: AI-Native systems require specialized cloud architectures that can handle the unique demands of machine learning workloads. These architectures must support distributed training, real-time inference, and continuous model updates.

chapter-2/topic-2.title: Data Pipeline Design
chapter-2/topic-2.description: Data pipelines are the backbone of AI-Native systems, connecting data sources to ML models and providing the information needed for both training and inference.

chapter-3/index.title: Chapter 3: Model Development and Deployment
chapter-3/index.description: This chapter covers the complete lifecycle of AI models from initial development through production deployment and ongoing management.

chapter-3/topic-1.title: Training and Fine-tuning
chapter-3/topic-1.description: Training and fine-tuning are fundamental processes in AI-Native development that determine the capabilities and performance of models.

chapter-3/topic-2.title: Deployment Strategies
chapter-3/topic-2.description: Deploying AI models requires specialized considerations for performance, scalability, and reliability.

chapter-4/index.title: Chapter 4: AI-Enabled User Interfaces
chapter-4/index.description: This chapter explores how artificial intelligence can enhance user interfaces, creating more adaptive and intelligent experiences.

chapter-4/topic-1.title: Adaptive UI Components
chapter-4/topic-1.description: Adaptive UI components modify their behavior and presentation based on user interactions, context, and preferences, creating more personalized and efficient experiences.

chapter-4/topic-2.title: Conversational Interfaces
chapter-4/topic-2.description: Conversational interfaces enable natural language interactions between users and systems, representing one of the most intuitive forms of AI-enabled UI.

chapter-5/index.title: Chapter 5: Monitoring and Evolution
chapter-5/index.description: This chapter focuses on how to monitor AI-Native systems and ensure they continue to perform effectively over time.

chapter-5/topic-1.title: Model Performance Tracking
chapter-5/topic-1.description: Model performance tracking is critical for maintaining the effectiveness and reliability of AI-Native systems in production environments.

chapter-5/topic-2.title: Adaptive System Updates
chapter-5/topic-2.description: AI-Native systems must adapt to changing conditions through continuous updates that maintain performance while minimizing disruption.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: Welcome to AI-Native Driven Development, a comprehensive guide to building applications that are designed from the ground up with artificial intelligence at their core.
